post.title: Shorted on pay? Federal law can make your boss pay double
post.ig:
Shorted on pay? Your boss can owe you double.

Under the federal Fair Labor Standards Act, unpaid minimum wage or overtime comes with an equal amount in liquidated damages, plus attorney's fees.
The deadline: 2 years, or 3 if the violation was willful.
Example: 5 unpaid overtime hours a week at $20/hr is $7,800 a year, or $15,600 with damages.
The Labor Department recovered $259 million in back wages for 176,957 workers in fiscal 2025, the most since 2019.

Sources: Fair Labor Standards Act (29 U.S.C. 216, 255), US Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division, EPI.
News and education, not financial advice.
